profile.title: Profile & settings
landingV2.hero.body: An intelligent purchasing companion that discovers opportunities, evaluates risk, and handles the buying journey — while your rules remain in control of every payment.
landingV2.hero.scroll: Scroll to see how it works
landingV2.preview.title: Purchase proposal
landingV2.preview.assessmentValue: Eligible for buyer checkout · sample only
landingV2.preview.noPayment: No live policy decision, order or payment exists in this preview.
landingV2.preview.plannedSteps: Later steps shown as a flow, not live states
landingV2.problem.title: Autonomy should not mean giving up control.
landingV2.problem.body: Discovery can be automated. Financial authority still needs boundaries, explainability, and accountable approval.
landingV2.problem.unrestrictedBody: An agent can move quickly. It should never hold unlimited authority over a buyer’s money.
landingV2.problem.unclearBody: Buyers need to see the product, seller signals, price, and conditions behind every proposal.
landingV2.problem.releaseBody: Payment operations must follow explicit policy and verified transaction events.
landingV2.how.title: Intelligence handles the journey. Your rules control the money.
landingV2.how.body: AI prepares the next step; policy owns the decision. Each stage has a clear responsibility.
landingV2.how.discoverBody: A connected agent can find listings and opportunities.
landingV2.how.evaluateBody: Review product details, pricing, seller signals, and risks.
landingV2.how.enforceBody: The deterministic engine checks the exact proposal against the active mandate.
landingV2.how.confirmBody: Exceptions need guardian approval; buyer and seller confirmations stay independent.
landingV2.how.settleBody: A future payment adapter may request capture after required confirmations. PayPal is not connected.
landingV2.how.boundary: AI recommendations do not authorize a purchase or payment.
landingV2.architecture.title: Three layers. One accountable purchasing flow.
landingV2.architecture.body: The agent can research and propose. The policy engine owns eligibility; payment operations remain behind verified provider controls.
landingV2.architecture.aiBody: Finds and explains options; it cannot write transaction decisions.
landingV2.architecture.policyBody: One explicit rules evaluation determines proposal eligibility.
landingV2.architecture.paymentBody: Provider integration is future work; no PayPal account is connected.
landingV2.architecture.guardrail: Agent output cannot override policy. Provider outcomes must be verified, never assumed.
landingV2.features.title: Control built into each stage.
landingV2.features.body: A clear boundary from discovery through any future settlement. Availability varies; planned capabilities are labelled.
landingV2.features.discoveryBody: Planned: find and compare product and seller listings.
landingV2.features.riskBody: Planned: explain seller, pricing, and listing signals.
landingV2.features.mandateBody: Configure a local preview of spending, category, meetup, and risk rules.
landingV2.features.limitsBody: The domain engine evaluates amounts using integer minor units.
landingV2.features.guardianBody: The review screen is a preview; authenticated approvals are future work.
landingV2.features.checkinsBody: Planned after a payment authorization is confirmed.
landingV2.features.handoffBody: Planned buyer and seller confirmations before capture.
landingV2.features.captureBody: The PayPal adapter is not implemented or connected.
landingV2.features.auditBody: Domain events are in-memory; durable audit storage is future work.
landingV2.final.title: Give your agent the freedom to act. Keep the authority to decide.
landingV2.final.body: Experience purchasing automation built around financial control, transparent decisions, and human accountability.
landingV2.footer.body: Autonomous purchasing with clear rules and human-controlled financial authority.
landingV2.footer.disclaimer: Illustrative preview · no live payments or connected PayPal account
paypalCallback.returnBody: PayPal redirected you back to Safe Mandate. This browser redirect does not confirm order approval, authorization, or payment. The backend has not verified the order status.
paypalCallback.cancelBody: PayPal returned you through the cancel link. Safe Mandate has not checked the order with PayPal, so no payment outcome is confirmed.
paypalCallback.checkingBody: Safe Mandate is checking the returned order with PayPal. No capture is being requested.
paypalCallback.successBody: The backend confirmed the authorization with PayPal for this order. The payment has not been captured; capture remains gated on check-in and both parties' handoff confirmations.
paypalCallback.unresolvedBody: The backend could not confirm the authorization outcome. No payment was captured. Check provider status before taking another action.
paypalCallback.failedBody: The backend did not confirm a valid PayPal authorization for this transaction. No payment success is shown.
paypalCallback.missingBody: The return link did not include an order token. Safe Mandate cannot verify or authorize this checkout.
paypalCallback.sessionTitle: This checkout session could not be matched.
paypalCallback.sessionBody: The short-lived buyer session for this checkout is unavailable or expired. Sign in again and review the transaction status.
paypalCallback.mismatchTitle: The returned order did not match.
paypalCallback.mismatchBody: The PayPal order token did not match the order stored for this transaction. No authorization was requested.
paypalCheckout.heading: Your purchases
paypalCheckout.description: Review transactions stored by Safe Mandate. PayPal checkout is available only when the backend reports the transaction as payment eligible.
paypalCheckout.signInDescription: Sign in to load your persisted transactions. Your bearer token stays in memory except for the short checkout return handoff, where it is kept in this tab's session storage.
paypalCheckout.unresolved: The backend could not return a verified PayPal approval link. Reconcile the provider status before retrying.
paypalCheckout.changeSearch: Change the search or status filter and try again.
paypalCheckout.noTransactionsHelp: Transactions must be created and evaluated by the backend before a payment action is available.
paypalCheckout.noCaptureHere: Checkout creates an authorization only. Capture is not available here.
paypalCheckout.controlTitle: Human approval and verified policy stay in control.
paypalCheckout.controlBody: Safe Mandate sends the persisted amount and transaction reference only. The backend validates the mandate, merchant, order, and PayPal status. No browser redirect can confirm payment.
paypalCheckout.checkoutError: Could not start the PayPal checkout. The backend transaction was not changed by the browser.
paypalCheckout.loadError: Could not load transactions from the Safe Mandate backend.
ai.signInTitle: Sign in to your buyer account
ai.signInBody: The copilot uses your saved mandate for a separate deterministic policy check. Your session token stays in this page's memory only.
ai.listingPlaceholder: Paste the listing text. Treat every seller claim as unverified until you check it.
ai.conversationPlaceholder: Paste relevant messages. Remove phone numbers, addresses, and other private details first.
ai.advisory: AI analysis is advisory. It cannot approve a purchase or move money.
ai.providerDisclosure: Listing and conversation text will be sent to the server's configured AI provider. Raw text is not retained in the assessment audit.
ai.noPolicy: Run alongside the AI. This result comes from your saved mandate and the structured purchase details, not from the model.
ai.evaluationOnly: Evaluation only · no transaction or payment was created.
ai.unconfigured: AI is not configured on this server. Add the AI provider settings before requesting an assessment.
ai.inputLimit: Each text field is limited to 8,000 characters.
ai.noFindings: No specific evidence-backed risk finding was identified. This is not a guarantee of safety.
ai.error: The assessment could not be completed. Your purchase and payment state were not changed.
ai.savedPolicy: Policy evaluation uses persisted transaction details.
ai.standalonePolicy: Policy evaluation uses the structured details you entered and your saved mandate.
ai.messageReview: Nothing is sent to the seller. Review and send any draft yourself.
